faq.q: Can reps use Trackeys with no internet signal?
faq.a: Yes. The mobile app is offline-first: visits, orders, invoices and payments all work without connectivity. Data syncs automatically when signal returns, with conflict-free merge for any edits made on the server while the device was offline.

faq.q: How does the AI copilot make suggestions?
faq.a: The copilot runs on aggregated visit history, order patterns and customer attributes. It suggests next-best-actions (upsell, cross-sell, re-engagement) and flags churn risk — always with a short explanation so the rep understands the reasoning.

faq.q: Does it support multiple currencies, taxes and languages?
faq.a: Yes. Multi-currency pricing, multi-tax jurisdictions (VAT, GST), and localized UI for English, Arabic, French and other regional languages are built in.

faq.q: How are pricing and discount rules enforced?
faq.a: Pricing rules, approval limits and discount tiers are configured per role and per customer segment. Reps can only quote within their authority; anything above routes to an approval workflow with a full audit trail.
